messages:
anya: FYI AtlasHealth on-prem reported a gap in audit logs after yesterday's RBAC cleanup. Compliance team noticed ~45m without syslog entries.

kevin: What changed in the RBAC sweep?

anya: We rolled `rbac/sweep-2026-03` at ~02:05 UTC. It removed some clusterrolebindings and normalized SAs (deploy-agent -> deploy-agent-restricted).

hugo: Did the splunk forwarder or the KMS mapping rely on the old SA name?

anya: Logs from the forwarder show permission errors immediately after deploy: 
```
Mar 15 02:07:12 forwarder[pid]: open /var/log/kube-audit.log: permission denied
Mar 15 02:07:18 forwarder[pid]: tail failed: EOF
Mar 15 02:07:25 forwarder[pid]: sending heartbeat to splunk managed collector
```
KMS agent shows: `ERROR: kms-client: access denied for key atlas-prod-enc (principal system:serviceaccount:atlas:deploy-agent)`

maria: That screams SA name mismatch to me. On private installs we map key ACLs to SA identities at install-time. If the SA was renamed or replaced, KMS policy still references the old principal.

kevin: Quick triage checklist: 1) check existing clusterrolebinding names, 2) verify forwarder SA can read hostPath logs, 3) verify KMS policy principals.

hugo: I ran `kubectl get clusterrolebinding | egrep 'deploy-agent|deploy-agent-restricted'` and found the old CRB removed and a new restricted one present. Forwarder SA is `atlas-splunk` and still has a RoleBinding for log read, but the node-level sidecar that tails /var/log is using `deploy-agent` SA (legacy).

anya: So two things: forwarder tailer uses legacy SA, and KMS key alias `atlas-prod-enc` still lists legacy SA in its ACL. That would cause both audit gap and KMS 403s.

kevin: Remediation proposal (quick patch):
- create a narrow emergency ClusterRoleBinding for `deploy-agent` with only `get` on secrets and `read` on hostPath mounts\- update KMS key principal to include `deploy-agent-restricted` OR map the legacy SA to the new one in the KMS ACLs (safer to add new principal first)\- run audit backfill into Splunk\- add CI gate to prevent RBAC sweeps from removing principals referenced by KMS or audit sinks

hugo: Minimal emergency manifest I used in staging: 
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: deploy-agent-emergency-readonly
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: read-host-logs
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: deploy-agent
  namespace: atlas
```
Applied this and forwarder resumed tailing. Backlog started moving.

anya: KMS still returning intermittent 403s for calls from `kv-sync`. The key ACL for `atlas-prod-enc` shows only `system:serviceaccount:atlas:deploy-agent`.

maria: Add `system:serviceaccount:atlas:deploy-agent-restricted` to the key ACL temporarily, then schedule key rotation with a short TTL so any accidental tokens are invalidated. Also add an alert rule: page if KMS 403s > 5% over 5m for any key.

kevin: On backfill: use `rd-auditctl backfill --src s3://atlas-audit/2026-03-15/ --to splunk://collector:8088 --since 02:05 --dry-run` then live run after KMS fix. Dry-run shows ~1.4k missing events.

ops-bot: Incident created: ONPREM-AUDIT-GAP-1765439999. Severity: P2. Actions assigned: anya (apply emergency binding, run backfill), kevin (update KMS ACL + rotate keys), hugo (CI preflight for RBAC sweeps).

anya: Will also script the emergency CRB as a reversible job in the installer so deletes can be rolled back automatically if audit sinks stop receiving data after an RBAC change.

maria: Follow-up items for postmortem: 1) CI check that `kms:principal` references are present in RBAC PR diffs, 2) add a preflight job that queries installer metadata to ensure SA renames are propagated to external ACLs, 3) document the minimal emergency manifest in runbooks.

kevin: I'm opening PRs: one adds `kms-principal-check` to the RBAC sweeper CI, another adds an alert and a short-lived emergency CRB job template.

hugo: After the ACL update and key rotation, re-run the backfill and verify sequence numbers in Splunk. If anything above an expected threshold is missing, escalate to AtlasHealth compliance for review.

anya: Thanks all. I'll coordinate the backfill once kevin confirms KMS ACL change. Closing loop in this thread after validation. :thumbsup:
